blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Contract inference requires multiple judgments about a shared document, but aggregate accuracy can conceal changes in the individual decisions. Repeated agreement is also insufficient: a model may consistently return the wrong answer. In this paper, we compare Jev with nine language models on ContractNLI, evaluating inference cost, response time, average correctness, and correctness across repeated request conditions. Controlled comparisons vary hypothesis visibility, requested outputs, and output order while keeping the contract and target judgment fixed. Jev has the lowest cost and median response time among the evaluated configurations, while hosted language models achieve higher baseline accuracy. Rankings by baseline accuracy differ from rankings by correctness across every condition and repeat, although small differences in the latter do not establish a general stability advantage. Development diagnostics further reveal compensating corrections and regressions, as well as persistent errors. These findings motivate evaluating cost and response time alongside whether individual judgments remain correct as the request configuration changes. Code: GitHub .
blocks.zh: 合同推论要求对共享文件作出多项判断,但总的准确性可以掩盖个别决定的变化。 反复达成协议也是不够的:一个模型可能始终退回错误的答案。 在本文中,我们将Jev与ContractNLI上的9种语言模型进行比较,评价推论成本,反应时间,平均正确性,以及反复请求条件的正确性. 控制下的比较在维持合同和目标判断不变的同时,也不同假设可见度、要求的产出和产出顺序。 Jev在被评价的配置中成本和中位响应时间最低,而主机语言模型则实现了更高的基线精确度. 按基线准确性排列的排名与按每个条件的正确性排列的排名不同,而且重复出现,尽管后者的微小差异并没有确立一般的稳定性优势. 发展诊断进一步揭示了补偿性纠正和回归以及持续的错误。 这些结果促使人们评价费用和反应时间,同时,随着请求配置的变化,个别判断是否依然正确。 代码:GitHub.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Contract review requires several judgments about one document: whether information is confidential, whether copies may be made, and what obligations remain after termination ( Koreeda and Manning, 2021 ; Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) . These judgments can be requested jointly or separately, while their intended answers remain tied to the contract. A model’s practical value therefore depends on the cost and time required to obtain its answers and their correctness across request configurations, beyond accuracy in a single configuration.
blocks.zh: 合同审查要求就一份文件作出若干判断:资料是否保密,是否可以复制副本,终止合同后仍有哪些义务(Koreeda和Manning,2021年;Hendrycks等人,2021年)。 这些判决可以联合或单独提出,而其预期答案仍与合同挂钩。 因此,一个模型的实际价值取决于获得答案所需的成本和时间及其在各种请求配置中的正确性,超出单一配置的准确性。

blocks.en: One difficulty is that aggregate accuracy conceals which judgments change. Behavioral testing examines individual predictions ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ) , while studies of batching, position, demonstration order, and prompt formatting reveal request sensitivity ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2022 ; Sclar et al., 2024 ) . A recent preprint likewise shows that similar ranking quality can coexist with different downstream decisions ( Frohmann et al., 2026 ) . For judgments sharing one contract, corrections and regressions can cancel each other out even when many decisions differ. Figure 1 (panel 2) illustrates this concern: Qwen3.5-4B changes its prediction for a fixed development-set judgment when more hypotheses become visible, although only the target label is requested.
blocks.zh: 一个困难是,总的准确性掩盖了判决的变化。 行为测试检查个人预测(Ribeiro等人,2020年),同时研究分批,位置,演示顺序,以及快速格式化揭示请求敏感性(Lin等人,2024年;Lu等人,2022年;Sclar等人,2024年). 最近的一个预印也表明,类似的排名质量可以与不同的下游决定共存(Frohmann等人,2026年). 对于分享一项合同的判决,即使许多判决不同,纠正和回归也可以相互取消。 图1 (第2小组) 说明了这种担忧: Quen3.5-4B在更多假说可见时会改变其对固定的开发设置判断的预测,尽管只要求目标标签.

blocks.en: A second difficulty is that agreement does not establish correctness: a model may repeat an incorrect label across every condition. Variation can also arise when an unchanged request is repeated. Evaluation must therefore score persistent answers against gold labels and use unchanged repetitions as a reference for variability. Examining these behaviors alongside cost follows HELM’s multidimensional perspective ( Liang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 第二个困难是协议不能确定正确性:一个模型可能在每个条件上重复不正确的标签. 当一个不变的请求重复出现时,也可能出现变异. 因此,评价必须对照金色标签对持续答案进行评分,并使用不变的重复作为可变性的参考。 以HELM的多面性视角来审视这些行为(梁等人,2023年),

blocks.en: These considerations motivate a paired study of Jev and generative language models centered on three questions. RQ1: What trade-offs between cost, response time, and accuracy do Jev and its comparators exhibit? RQ2: Does higher accuracy imply that more judgments remain correct across repeated request conditions? RQ3: Which decisions change when visible hypotheses, requested outputs, or their order change? We address these questions by preserving target judgments and gold labels across controlled conditions, retaining invalid responses in the accuracy denominator, and estimating uncertainty at the contract level.
blocks.zh: 这些考虑促使对Jev和以三个问题为中心的基因语言模型进行了对等研究。 问题1: Jev及其参照者在成本、反应时间和准确性之间有什么权衡? RQ2: 更高的准确性是否意味着,在重复的请求条件中,更多的判决仍然正确? RQ3 : (英语). 哪些决定在可见假设、要求的产出或命令改变时会改变? 我们通过在受控制条件下保留目标判断和金色标签、保留准确分母的无效答复以及估计合同一级的不确定性来解决这些问题。

blocks.en: Our main evaluation uses the official ContractNLI test split for accuracy and a preselected subset for stability; all ten models complete both evaluations. Separate development analyses include earlier diagnostics that motivated the controlled design and additional comparisons collected after the test results were inspected. Three API comparators extend the original model selection using the same task, samples, and scoring rules.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要评价采用正式的ContractNLI测试分精度和预选的子集来进行稳定性;所有10种模型都完成了两种评价。 单独的开发分析包括早期的诊断,这些诊断促使进行控制下的设计,以及在检查测试结果后收集的额外比较。 3个API比较器使用相同的任务,样本,和评分规则来扩展原始模型选择.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A paired cost–accuracy evaluation of Jev and its comparators on fixed contract judgments, relating classification quality to response time and inference expenditure under explicit pricing assumptions (Sections 2 – 4 ). • An evaluation of average and persistent correctness that distinguishes their observed rankings and compares them on shared targets, with paired uncertainty estimates to define the scope of the conclusions (Section 4 ). • Controlled behavioral diagnostics that reveal compensating corrections and regressions, distinguish persistent correctness from stable errors, and interpret request sensitivity alongside repetition under unchanged conditions (Appendices B and D – E ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:对Jev及其参照方进行固定合同判决的对等成本准确性评价,根据明确的定价假设,将答复时间和推断支出的分类质量包括在内(第2至第4节)。 评估平均和持续正确性,以区分观察到的排名,并将其与共同的目标进行比较,并配对不确定性估计,以确定结论的范围(第4节)。 · 控制下的行为诊断,揭示补偿性纠正和回归,区分持续正确性和稳定错误,并解释请求敏感性,同时在不变的条件下重复(附录B和D-E)。

blocks.en: An anchor is consistently correct only when every response across the four conditions and three repeats gives the correct label. A stable error consists of twelve valid, identical, but incorrect labels. The remaining outcomes consist of either twelve valid labels that change, or a set containing at least one invalid response. These mutually exclusive categories distinguish persistent correctness from agreement alone, with every selected anchor retained in the denominator. Within-condition repeat disagreement separately describes variation under unchanged requests.

blocks.en: We also compare average and persistent correctness on identical targets by averaging correctness over all 360 anchor responses, again counting invalid responses as incorrect. Unlike the broader baseline accuracy, this mean and all-twelve correctness concern the same targets. The mean weights every response equally; all-twelve correctness requires every response for a target to succeed. Their relationship therefore depends on how errors are distributed across targets and cannot be inferred from the mean alone.

blocks.en: 3 Data and Experimental Protocol
blocks.zh: 3 数据和实验议定书

blocks.en: 3.1 Data and uncertainty
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据和不确定性

blocks.en: The official ContractNLI test split contains 123 contracts and 2,091 judgments: 968 entailments, 220 contradictions, and 903 not-mentioned labels ( Koreeda and Manning, 2021 ) . We preserve full contract text, all original hypotheses, and their annotations. Evidence spans are excluded from model inputs. The stability panel selects 30 test contracts and one anchor per contract using seed 20260922 and document-specific anchor seeds, independently of labels and model predictions. The panel is a subset of the accuracy evaluation, so these are complementary analyses of overlapping contracts.
blocks.zh: 官方ContractNLI测试拆分包含123项合同和2,091项判决:968项内涵,220项矛盾,以及903项未提及标签(Koreeda and Manning, 2021). 我们保留合同全文, 所有原始假设, 和他们的说明。 模型投入中不包括证据跨度。 稳定面板利用20260922种子和文档专用锚种子,选择30份测试合同和每份合同1个锚地,独立于标签和模型预测. 小组是准确性评价的一个子集,因此这些是对重叠合同的补充分析。

blocks.en: Each model receives 123 requests in the accuracy evaluation and 360 in the stability evaluation. The latter yields 90 primary judgments per condition from 30 independent contract targets. We estimate uncertainty using 5,000 whole-contract bootstrap resamples with seed 20260922, preserving paired observations when comparing models. The resulting intervals are descriptive and unadjusted for multiple comparisons ( Dror et al., 2018 ) . Repeated requests supply additional observations of the same contracts, rather than additional independent contracts.
blocks.zh: 每个模型在准确性评价中收到123项请求,在稳定性评价中收到360项请求. 后者从30个独立的合同目标中得出每个条件90项主要判决。 我们使用5 000个装有20260922种种子的全合同靴子重新标本来估计不确定性,在比较模型时保留配对观测。 由此产生的间隔是描述性的,对多项比较没有调整(Dror等人,2018年)。 重复提出的请求对同样的合同提供了补充意见,而不是额外的独立合同。

blocks.en: The task, test inputs, target selection, and scoring rules were fixed before test inference. The configurations for Jev, both Qwen models, both Gemini models, Luna, and Astra were fixed before their respective test evaluations. Sonnet, Haiku, and Terra were added after inspecting earlier results; their configurations were fixed before collecting their test predictions, and they use the same samples and evaluation rules. The ten-model comparison therefore does not constitute a wholly prospective model selection. The development experiments use separate contracts and are analyzed separately; their later extension follows inspection of the test results (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 任务,测试输入,目标选择,评分规则在测试推论前被固定. Jev的配置,两者都是Quen模型,双子座模型,Luna和Astra都是在各自测试评价之前固定的. Sonnet, Haiku,和Terra在检查了早期的结果后被添加;它们的配置在收集测试预测之前被固定,它们使用相同的样本和评价规则. 因此,十种模式的比较并不是一种完全可能的模型选择。 开发试验采用单独的合同,并分别分析;其后在检查试验结果后延长(附录C)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Models and inference
blocks.zh: 3.2 模型和推论

blocks.en: We compare Jev 1.13.0 with Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and 3.1 Pro Preview, GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Sonnet 5, and Claude Haiku 4.5. Jev receives the contract as shared state and each requested hypothesis as a native Choice question. Generative models receive semantically aligned classification instructions and return a JSON label map. The baseline and controlled catalog prompts differ, but each is fixed across its corresponding comparisons. Appendix F gives the classification instruction.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了Jev 1.13.0与Quen3.5-4B和9B,双子座3.5 Flash-Lite和3.1 Pro预览,GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra,GPT-6 Astra,Claude Sonnet 5和Claude Haiku 4.5. Jev作为共享状态收到合同,每个要求的假说作为本土选择问题. 基因模型收到精密一致的分类说明,并返回一个JSON标签地图. 基准和受控目录的提示不同,但每个都固定在相应的比较中。 附 录 F给出分类指导.

blocks.en: Flash-Lite uses minimal thinking, Gemini Pro low thinking, Luna no reasoning, and Astra high reasoning. Terra uses medium reasoning with a 16,384-token output allowance. Sonnet uses adaptive thinking with medium effort and the same allowance; Haiku disables thinking with an 8,192-token allowance. The three added models are accessed through a common third-party gateway, whereas Luna and Astra use their original OpenRouter route. These provider-specific operating points do not equalize computation or actual reasoning length.
blocks.zh: Flash-Lite使用最小思维,双子座Pro低思维,Luna无推理,Astra高推理. Terra使用中等推理,并有16,384个托肯输出允许. Sonnet采用适应性思维,但努力程度中等,津贴相同;Haiku以8,192托肯津贴使思维丧失能力。 新增的这三种模型通过一个共同的第三方网关访问,而Luna和Astra则使用他们最初的OpenRouter路线. 这些提供商特有的操作点并不等于计算或实际推理长度.

blocks.en: Both Qwen test configurations use BF16, enabled thinking, temperature 1, top- p p 0.95, and a shared allowance of 32,768 tokens for reasoning and the final answer. They use native model templates, one GPU per model, and no separate reasoning cutoff. Their historical development configurations disable thinking; a paired development comparison in Appendix K examines the complete configuration change. No test prompts or settings are selected from model performance.
blocks.zh: Quen两种测试配置都使用BF16,允许思维,温度1,顶端-p0.95,以及32,768个用于推理和最终答案的共享允许. 他们使用本土模型模板,每个模型一个GPU,没有单独的推理截断. 它们的历史发展配置会禁用思维;附录K中的对称发展比较会检查完整的配置变化. 没有从模型性能中选择测试提示或设置 。

blocks.en: Requests are issued sequentially for each model, while different models may run concurrently. Stability conditions and repetitions are shuffled within each contract using the fixed schedule. No failed evaluation attempt is repaired, replaced, or automatically retried. Model-specific response interfaces remain part of the evaluated configuration. In particular, Jev’s C/D intervention changes question-key order; it is not equivalent to an autoregressive output-position intervention, and requested output order need not match internal reasoning order.
blocks.zh: 每种模式按顺序发出请求,而不同的模式可能同时运行。 在每个合同中,稳定条件和重复使用固定时间表。 没有失败的评估尝试被修复、替换或自动重试 。 模型特定响应接口仍然是评价配置的一部分. 特别是,Jev的C/D干预会改变问题键顺序;它不等同于自动输出位置干预,所请求的产出命令不需要符合内部推理命令.

blocks.en: 3.3 Cost and timing
blocks.zh: 3.3 费用和时间

blocks.en: Quality and cost are measured over the same requests, including failed attempts. For Luna and Astra, API costs use provider-reported charges; for other API models, we multiply recorded token usage by the public input, output, and cache prices applicable to the evaluation. When usage is missing, its cost remains unknown, and we report the known subtotal and coverage separately. Baseline cost is averaged over the 123 baseline contracts; stability cost is reported separately for its 360 requests.
blocks.zh: 质量和成本是用同样的要求来衡量的,包括失败的尝试。 就Luna和Astra而言,API的成本使用供应商报告的费用;就其他API模型而言,我们用公共投入、产出和适用于评价的缓存价格乘以记录的象征性使用。 在没有使用时,其成本仍然不明,我们分别报告已知的小计和覆盖面。 基线费用平均为123项基线合同;其360项请求的稳定性费用另行报告。

blocks.en: For each local model, rental-equivalent baseline cost is C ^ GPU = r 123 × 3600 ​ ∑ d = 1 123 t d , \widehat{C}_{\mathrm{GPU}}=\frac{r}{123\times 3600}\sum_{d=1}^{123}t_{d}, (1) where t d t_{d} is the measured request time and r r is $2.00 per GPU-hour. Each model uses one GPU. This is a valuation of observed local inference time, not a measured bill or a claim about cloud throughput. The declared reference rate and hardware differences are documented in Appendix C ; loading, idle allocation, storage, transfer, and taxes are excluded. Latency also reflects network, scheduling, caching, and provider infrastructure. An observed cost–accuracy frontier therefore describes these measured configurations and pricing assumptions.
blocks.zh: 每个本地模型的租金等价基线成本为C ^ GPU = r 123× 3600∑ d = 1 123 t d,\widehat{C}_{\mathrm{GPU}}=\frac{r}{123\tims 3600}\sum_{d=1}^{123}t_{d}, (1) 其中 t d d}是测量的请求时间,r是每GPU小时2美元. 每个模型都使用一个GPU. 这是对观察到的当地推断时间的估价,而不是计量的账单或对云吞吐量的索赔. 所申报的参考率和硬件差异载于附录C;加载、闲置分配、储存、转让和税收不包括在内。 延迟还反映了网络、调度、缓存和供应商基础设施。 因此,一个观察到的成本准确性前沿说明了这些计量的配置和定价假设。

blocks.en: Response time uses recorded client elapsed time, including request preparation, connection establishment, network transfer, service-side processing, and response validation. All test collections use the same client machine, with one in-flight request per model and no retries. We report the median and 95th percentile (P95), retaining failed attempts. These measurements describe the evaluated deployments; separate model computation, queueing time, and time to first token were not recorded.
blocks.zh: 反应时间使用记录客户端通过时间,包括请求准备,连接建立,网络传输,服务端处理,以及反应验证. 所有测试收藏都使用同一客户端机,每个型号都有一个飞行中的请求,没有复试. 我们报告中位数和95%(P95),保留失败的尝试。 这些测量方法描述了所评价的部署;没有记录单独的模型计算,排队时间,以及到达第一令牌的时间.

blocks.en: 4 Results on the Official Test Split
blocks.zh: 4 正式测试分拆的结果

blocks.en: The official-test comparison separates four aspects of performance: inference expenditure, response time, baseline accuracy, and correctness across repeated conditions. All ten models complete the 123-contract baseline and the 30-contract stability panel, with failed requests retained in the intended denominators. Figure 2 summarizes the comparison, and Tables 1 and 2 detail baseline and repeated-target correctness. Appendix A provides condition-level scores and paired uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 官方-测试比较将性能分为四个方面:推论支出,反应时间,基准准确性,以及反复出现的情况的正确性. 所有10个模型都完成了123份合同基线和30份合同稳定性小组的工作,在预定分母中保留了失败的请求。 图2汇总了比较情况,表1和表2详细列出了基线和重复目标正确性。 附 录 A提供条件等级分数和配对不确定性.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Jev 1.13.0 occupies the lowest-cost end of this comparison, while Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview attains the highest baseline accuracy. Coordinates summarize 123 official-test contracts (2,091 judgments); bubble area gives the fraction of 30 preselected anchors in distinct test contracts answered correctly in all four conditions and three repeats. All 360 planned stability requests per model enter the evaluation, and invalid responses cannot satisfy All 12 correct. The dotted frontier connects nondominated point estimates under the cost accounting in Section 3 . Tables 1 and 3 report confidence intervals; the connecting segments do not represent intermediate configurations or significant differences.
blocks.zh: 图2:Jev 1.13.0占据了这一比较的最低成本端,而双子座3.1 Pro Preview则达到最高的基准精度. 坐标汇总了123份正式测试合同(2,091份判决书);气泡区给出了30个预选锚在不同的测试合同中的比例,在所有4个条件和3个重复中都得到正确回答。 每个模型的所有360个计划稳定性请求都输入评价,无效的答复不能满足全部12个正确. 第3节中成本核算项下的非主导点估计数与虚线连接在一起。 表1和表3报告置信间隔;连接段不代表中间配置或显著差异.

blocks.en: Table 1: Official-test baseline: 123 contracts and 2,091 judgments per model. Failed requests remain incorrect; cost and median client response time include all 123 attempts. Accuracy intervals use 5,000 whole-contract bootstrap samples, without multiplicity adjustment. Section 3 defines cost and timing. ↑ \uparrow / ↓ \downarrow : higher/lower is better. Bold and underlining mark the best and second-best distinct values in columns with arrows, including ties; these marks do not imply statistical significance.
blocks.zh: 表1:正式测试基线:123项合同和2 091项判决。 失败的请求仍然不正确;成本和中位客户响应时间包括所有123次尝试. 准确间隔使用5 000个全合同靴套样本,不作多重调整。 第3节规定了费用和时间。 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}你应该知道 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080} 高/低比较好。 在有箭头的柱子中粗体和下划线标出最佳和次佳的数值,包括领带;这些标记并不意味着统计意义。

blocks.en: 4.1 RQ1: Cost, response time, and accuracy
blocks.zh: 4.1 RQ1:费用、反应时间和准确性

blocks.en: Jev achieves 77.38% accuracy at $0.000228 per contract. All seven hosted language-model comparators have higher accuracy point estimates, ranging from 78.96% for Luna to 83.21% for Gemini Pro. Flash-Lite gains 5.16 percentage points over Jev at approximately six times the cost. The strength of evidence for these gains differs: the paired 95% interval is 3.49–6.98 points for Flash-Lite minus Jev, but − 0.05 -0.05 –3.11 points for Luna minus Jev (Appendix A ). Thus, the higher observed scores do not establish a reliable improvement for every comparator.
blocks.zh: Jev的精度达到77.38%,每份合同0.0228美元。 所有7个主机语言模型参照器的准确度估计值都较高,从月球的78.96%到双子座Pro的83.21%不等. Flash-Lite比Jev增高5.16个百分点,约为成本的6倍. 这些增益的证据强度不同:组合的95%间距为Flash-Lite减Jev的3.49–6.98分,但Luna减Jev的0.05–0.05–3.11分(附录A). 因此,观察到的分数较高并不能为每个参照国带来可靠的改进。

blocks.en: Under the stated prices, Jev, Luna, Flash-Lite, and Gemini Pro form the observed cost–accuracy frontier. The three added comparators broaden model-family coverage without extending this two-dimensional frontier. Sonnet and Terra achieve accuracy close to Flash-Lite at higher costs; Haiku falls between Jev and Flash-Lite in accuracy while costing more than either. The comparison is specific to these operating points and pricing bases. Qwen4B and Qwen9B achieve 74.22% and 79.15%, respectively, including six and one baseline requests that exhaust the generation allowance before producing final labels.
blocks.zh: 根据上述价格,Jev、Luna、Flash-Lite和双子座Pro构成了所观察到的成本精确边界。 三个新增的参照国扩大了模式-家庭覆盖面,但没有扩大这一二维前沿。 Sonnet和Terra以更高的成本实现接近Flash-Lite的精度; Haiku在准确度上落在Jev和Flash-Lite之间,而成本则高于两者。 比较是针对这些操作点和定价基础的。 Quen4B和Quen9B分别实现了74.22%和79.15%,包括6个和1个基线请求,这些请求在制作最终标签前已经用尽了生成允许使用量.

blocks.en: Higher expenditure along the frontier does not yield a uniform return in accuracy. Gemini Pro costs 6.26 times as much as Flash-Lite for a gain of 0.67 percentage points, with a paired 95% interval of − 0.72 -0.72 –2.10 percentage points. It therefore has the highest accuracy point estimate, but no established advantage over Flash-Lite on this sample. Its all-twelve-correct count also exceeds Flash-Lite’s by only one target. Frontier membership describes the observed cost and quality coordinates; paired uncertainty indicates how strongly the sample supports a difference. Together, they inform model choice without identifying a universally preferred configuration.
blocks.zh: 沿边支出较高,不能产生一致的准确回报。 双子座Pro以0.67个百分点的增益成本为Flash-Lite的6.26倍,对比95%的间隔为−0.72-0.72-2.10个百分点. 因此它具有最高的精确点估计,但在这个样本上比Flash-Lite没有既定优势. 它的全十二正确计数也超过 Flash-Lite只用一个目标。 边际会籍描述观察到的成本和质量坐标;配对的不确定性表明样本支持差异的程度。 它们共同为模型选择提供信息,但没有确定普遍偏爱的配置。

blocks.en: Jev also has the lowest observed median baseline response time: 1.24 seconds, compared with 1.60 for Flash-Lite and 1.74 for Luna. Their P95 times are 1.59, 2.78, and 2.25 seconds, respectively. The full comparison, including slower reasoning-enabled configurations and failed attempts, appears in Appendix M .
blocks.zh: Jev也有观测到的最低中位响应时间:1.24秒,而Flash-Lite为1.60秒,Luna为1.74秒. 他们的P95次分别为1.59,2.78和2.25秒. 全面比较,包括较慢的推理辅助配置和失败的尝试,载于附录M。

blocks.en: At a fixed visible catalog of 17 hypotheses, requesting 17 labels instead of one (B–C) changes Jev’s median response time from 1.15 to 1.22 seconds, versus 0.99 to 1.86 for Flash-Lite and 1.10 to 1.78 for Luna. This small increase describes the observed service behavior. It does not identify internal parallelism: fixed network overhead and serving policies can also affect the increase. Accuracy and latency must both be considered when choosing a request configuration.
blocks.zh: 在17个假设的固定可见目录中,要求17个标签而不是一个(B-C)将Jev的中位响应时间从1.15秒改为1.22秒,而Flash-Lite的中位响应时间是0.99秒改为1.86秒,而Luna的中位响应时间是1.10秒改为1.78秒。 这个小的增加描述了观测到的服务行为. 它没有确定内部的平行性:固定的网络间接费用和服务政策也可能影响增长。 在选择请求配置时,既必须考虑准确性,也必须考虑到时间。

blocks.en: Pairing requests by contract and repeat gives a median B–C increase of 0.19 seconds for Jev (descriptive 95% interval: 0.06–0.24), 0.49 for Flash-Lite (0.45–0.58), and 0.67 for Luna (0.59–0.71). These summarize individual time differences, not differences between condition medians; intervals preserve all repeats within contracts. Rankings depend on the requested outputs: Flash-Lite has a lower median than Jev in B, whereas Jev has the lower median for joint prediction. Speed comparisons therefore require a specified workload.
blocks.zh: 按合同对等和重复的要求给Jev的B-C中位数增加0.19秒(说明95%的间隔:0.06-0.24),Flash-Lite的0.49(0.45-0.58)和Luna的0.67(0.59-0.71)。 这些摘要总结了个别时间差异,而不是条件中位数之间的差异;间隔保留合同内的所有重复。 排名取决于所要求的产出: Flash-Lite的中位数低于B的Jev,而Jev的中位数则低于联合预测. 因此,速度比较需要规定的工作量。

blocks.en: 4.2 RQ2: Correctness across repeated conditions
blocks.zh: 4.2 RQ2:反复出现的情况的正确性

blocks.en: Table 2: Mean correctness scores the same 30 test anchors across four conditions and three repeats (360 judgments); invalid responses count wrong. All 12 correct requires every answer to be correct. Remaining anchors have twelve identical wrong labels, twelve valid but changing labels, or an invalid response; invalidity takes precedence. The four outcome counts sum to 30. Bold / underlining mark the best/second-best distinct values in arrowed columns; they do not indicate significance.
blocks.zh: 表2:平均正确度在4个条件中得分相同的30个测试锚,3个重复(360个判断);无效反应计错. 所有12个正确都要求每个答案都正确. 其余锚有12个相同的错误标签,12个有效但更改的标签,或无效反应;无效优先。 四个结果计为30。 粗体/下划线在箭形栏中标出最佳/次最佳区分值;没有显示意义。

blocks.en: Sonnet keeps 24 of 30 anchors correct across all twelve responses, followed by Jev with 23. Gemini Pro, Luna, and Astra each retain 22, while Qwen9B retains 18 (Table 2 ). The Sonnet–Jev difference amounts to one target, with a paired 95% interval of − 10.00 -10.00 –16.67 percentage points; the panel therefore does not establish a general stability advantage for the comparison with Sonnet. Jev exceeds Haiku, Qwen9B, and Qwen4B by four, five, and six targets, respectively. The paired intervals exclude zero for Haiku and Qwen4B, while Qwen9B’s interval reaches zero. These unadjusted comparisons remain exploratory.
blocks.zh: Sonnet在所有12个响应中保持了30个主播中的24个正确,之后Jev以23个正确. 双子座Pro,Luna和Astra各保留22个,而Qun9B保留18个(表2 ). Sonnet–Jev的差值相当于一个目标,一对95%的间隔为-10.00–16.67个百分点;因此,小组没有为与Sonnet的比较确定一般的稳定性优势. Jev分别以4个,5个和6个目标分别超过了海库,Quen9B和Quen4B. Haiku和Quen4B的配对间隔排除为0,而Quen9B的间隔则达到0. 这些未经调整的比较仍然是探索性的。

blocks.en: Baseline accuracy and all-twelve correctness yield different observed rankings, but their target sets differ. To hold target composition fixed, Table 2 compares mean and persistent correctness within the stability panel. Jev answers 286 of its 360 anchor responses correctly (79.44%), and Qwen9B answers 285 (79.17%). These nearly identical means coexist with 23 versus 18 anchors that remain correct throughout. The paired mean difference, Qwen9B minus Jev, is − 0.28 -0.28 points (95% interval: − 9.44 -9.44 –10.00), which does not establish equivalence. The comparison nevertheless shows that the difference in persistent-correctness point estimates remains when both measures use identical targets.
blocks.zh: 基线准确性和全十二正确性得出了不同的观察到的排名,但其目标集不同. 为了固定目标构成,表2比较了稳定面板内的平均和持续正确性。 Jev在其360个主播回复中正确回答286个(79.44%),Qun9B回复285个(79.17%). 这些几乎完全相同的意味着与23对18的锚共存,这始终是正确的。 配对的平均差,Qwen9B减Jev,为−0.28-0.28分(95%间隔:−9.44-9.44–10.00),不能确定等值. 然而,比较表明,当两个衡量标准采用相同目标时,持续正确度点估计数的差异仍然存在。

blocks.en: The allocation of errors across targets explains this distinction. Jev has five anchors that receive the same wrong label throughout and two whose labels change. Qwen9B has two targets with consistently wrong labels, eight targets with changing valid labels, and two targets with invalid responses. Similar totals of correct responses can therefore leave different numbers of targets correct throughout. Agreement alone obscures another part of the comparison: Jev and Astra each repeat the same label on 28 of 30 targets, compared with Sonnet’s 25. However, five of Jev’s and six of Astra’s consistent labels are wrong, compared with one for Sonnet. Treating agreement as successful stability would reverse the interpretation of these outcomes.
blocks.zh: 不同目标之间的错误分配解释了这种区别。 Jev有5个主播,全程都收到同样的错误标签,还有2个主播的标签会改变. Qun9B有两个目标,标签始终错误,八个目标改变有效标签,两个目标反应无效. 因此,类似的正确反应总数可以使不同数量的目标始终正确。 协议本身就掩盖了比较的另一个部分: Jev和Astra在30个目标中的28个目标上都重复同样的标签,与Sonnet的25个相比. 然而,Jev的5个和Astra的6个一致标签是错误的,而Sonnet的标签是错的。 将协定视为成功的稳定,将扭转对这些结果的解释。

blocks.en: 4.3 RQ3: Changes hidden by average accuracy
blocks.zh: 4.3 RQ3:以平均准确性隐藏的变化

blocks.en: Figure 3: Label changes occur both across request conditions and under identical-request repetition. Results cover 30 preselected official-test contracts, with one anchor per contract and three repeats per condition. Cells show changed labels over jointly valid pairs; color encodes the corresponding percentage. Across-condition comparisons match the same anchor and repeat, while repetition cells use all three unordered repeat pairs per anchor, giving 90 planned pairs in every cell. A exposes and requests only the anchor; B exposes all hypotheses but requests the anchor; C requests all labels with the anchor first; D places it last. Invalid responses are excluded from these pairwise percentages, with the valid denominator shown in each cell, but count as incorrect in the accuracy and All 12 correct evaluations. All ten models complete the planned stability collection. A changed answer may improve or worsen correctness, so these rates do not measure performance degradation.
blocks.zh: 图3:标签的更改既发生在请求条件之间,也发生在相同请求重复的情况下。 结果包括30份预先选定的正式测试合同,每个合同有一个锚,每个条件有三次重复。 单元格在联合有效的对上显示更改的标签;颜色编码相应的百分比。 跨条件比较匹配同一锚和重复,而重复细胞每锚使用全部三个无序重复对,在每个细胞中给出90个计划对. A只曝光和请求主播;B曝光所有假设,但请求主播;C请求所有标签先与主播;D将其放置在最后. 无效的答复不包括在这些对偶百分比中,在每个单元格中显示有效的分母,但准确性不正确,所有12项评价都是正确的。 所有十种型号都完成了计划的稳定采集. 改变的答案可能改善或恶化正确性,因此这些比率不衡量性能退化。

blocks.en: Condition-level accuracy can remain unchanged even when the underlying decisions differ. For Qwen4B, A and B have identical accuracy, yet nine of 90 paired responses change: four regressions, four corrections, and one switch between wrong labels. Terra likewise has equal accuracy in B and C despite seven changed responses, comprising three regressions, three corrections, and one wrong-label switch. In both cases, the contract and target remain fixed, while opposing changes cancel in the aggregate score.
blocks.zh: 即使基本决定不同,但条件水平的准确性仍可保持不变。 对于Quen4B,A和B的精确度相同,然而90对响应中有9个变化:4个回归,4个修正,以及错误标签之间的1个切换. 同样,Terra在B和C的精确度也相同,尽管七个答复有所改变,包括三个回归、三个更正和一个错误的标签开关。 在这两种情况下,合同和目标保持不变,同时反对取消总分的变动。

blocks.en: Sensitivity to requested output order also varies across configurations. Haiku changes 14 of 90 paired responses from C to D, including twelve regressions and two corrections. Its accuracy falls by 11.11 percentage points (descriptive paired 95% interval: − 23.33 -23.33 to − 1.11 -1.11 ). Jev shows no C–D changes in this panel, although its question-key intervention differs from autoregressive output ordering and a finite sample with no changes does not establish invariance. Appendix A reports all transition counts and valid-pair coverage, retaining failures separately from valid label changes.
blocks.zh: 对请求输出顺序的敏感性也因配置而异. Haiku将90个对齐的答复中的14个从C改为D,包括12个回归和2个更正。 它的精度下降了11.11个百分点(描述性对95%间距:−23.33-23.33至−1.11-1.11). Jev显示这个面板没有C-D变化,尽管它的提问键干预不同于自动递归输出命令,一个没有变化的有限样本不能确定偏差. 附 录 报告所有过渡计数和有效保值,将失败与有效标签更改分开保留。

blocks.en: Unchanged-request repetition shows why cross-condition changes require a reference for variability. In Figure 3 , Qwen9B changes 15 of 90 valid pairs between A and B, alongside 12 of 90 repeat pairs within A and six of 90 within B. Its C–D comparison changes 12 of 88 valid pairs, while repeats within D change eleven of 86 valid pairs. Thus, variation is already present without altering the request condition. Because these counts describe different dependent comparisons, subtracting them would not estimate the causal contribution of an intervention. Directional transitions, unchanged-repeat variation, and invalid-response coverage together clarify what a single change rate leaves unresolved.
blocks.zh: 未经更改的重复请求表明,为什么交叉条件的改变需要参考可变性。 在图3中,Quen9B在A和B之间更改了90对有效配对中的15对,在A和B之间更改了90对重复配对中的12对,在B之间更改了90对重复配对中的6对。 它的C-D比较则更改了88对有效配对中的12对,而在D范围内更改了86对有效配对中的11对。 因此,在不改变请求条件的情况下已经存在变化。 因为这些计算可以描述不同的依赖性比较,减去它们不会估计干预的因果关系。 方向过渡、无变化的重复变异和无效反应的覆盖一起澄清了单一变化率留下的未决问题。

blocks.en: 4.4 Can incomplete answers explain the differences?
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 不完整的答案能否解释差异?

blocks.en: Generation-budget exhaustion lowers the Qwen scores, but cannot fully account for their difference from Flash-Lite. To bound the numerical effect of missing labels, we assign every missing label in a truncated baseline response its correct answer while holding all observed answers fixed. This deliberately optimistic calculation raises Qwen4B from 74.22% to at most 79.10% and Qwen9B from 79.15% to at most 79.96%, both below Flash-Lite’s observed 82.54%. These bounds do not replace the reported scores or predict what a larger generation allowance would achieve.
blocks.zh: 世代预算耗尽降低了Quen的分数,但不能完全说明它们与Flash-Lite的区别. 为了绑定缺失标签的数值效应,我们在短线基线响应中指定每一个缺失的标签正确答案,同时将所有观察到的答案固定. 这一刻意乐观的计算将Quen4B从74.22%提高到最多79.10%,将Quen9B从79.15%提高到最多79.96%,两者都低于Flash-Lite观察到的82.54%. 这些界限不能取代报告的分数,也不能预测更大的一代津贴将产生什么效果。

blocks.en: The anchor outcomes show that errors in completed answers also limit persistent correctness. Both Qwen9B targets with an invalid response already contain wrong answers among their other eleven responses: four for one target and one for the other. Correcting the two missing answers would therefore leave its all-twelve-correct count at 18. For Qwen4B, only two of the three affected targets have all remaining responses correct. Correct answers for all missing responses could raise its count from 17 to at most 19, still below Jev’s 23. The difference thus cannot be attributed solely to retaining truncated responses in the evaluation. Appendix L gives the termination evidence and scoring rationale.
blocks.zh: 定点结果显示,完成的答复中的错误也限制了持久性的正确性。 反应无效的Quen9B两个目标在其他11个答复中已经包含错误的答案:一个目标4个,另一个目标1个. 因此,纠正两个缺失的答案将使全部正确计算为18个。 对于Quen4B来说,三个受影响目标中只有两个有所有剩余的响应正确. 对所有缺失的答复的正确答案可能使其计数从17个增加到最多19个,但仍低于Jev的23个。 因此,不能将差异仅仅归因于在评价中保留短短的答复。 附 录 L给出了终止证据和评分理由.

blocks.en: 5 Development Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 5 发展诊断

blocks.en: Development experiments provide separate diagnostics under their original samples and settings (Appendices B – E ). Qwen4B changes 87 of 510 labels between joint and single-hypothesis requests, while its correct count changes by only four. In the disjoint anchor panel, A and B have equal accuracy but 24 of 90 responses change: twelve corrections and twelve regressions. Unchanged repeats within each arm agree, and Figure 1 shows one regression.
blocks.zh: 开发实验在其原始样本和设置下提供单独的诊断(附录B – E ). Quen4B在联想和单声道请求之间更改了510个标签中的87个,而其正确的计数只更改了4个. 在不相连的锚板中,A和B的准确性相同,但90个答复中有24个有变化:12个更正和12个回归。 每个臂内未改变的重复表示一致,图1显示一个回归.

blocks.en: A paired Qwen configuration comparison also finds higher mean correctness without a clear gain in all-twelve correctness, despite much greater token use. Reasoning, sampling, and output allowance change together; Appendix K reports the full comparison. These diagnostics motivate separating changes in visible hypotheses, requested outputs, and inference settings.
blocks.zh: 配对的Quen配置比较也发现,尽管符号使用量大得多,但是在全十二正确性上没有明显的收益,平均正确度更高. 理由、抽样和产出备抵一并改变;附录K报告全面比较。 这些诊断激发了在可见假说,请求输出和推论设置中区分变化的动力.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: ContractNLI, CUAD, and LegalBench evaluate contract inference, evidence extraction, and broader legal reasoning ( Koreeda and Manning, 2021 ; Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Guha et al., 2023 ) . We use ContractNLI’s existing labels to examine how request configuration affects multiple judgments about one document.
blocks.zh: ContractNLI、CUAD和Legal Bench评价合同推论、证据提取和更广泛的法律推理(Koreeda和Manning,2021年;Hendrycks等人,2021年;Guha等人,2023年)。 我们使用 ContractNLI 的现有标签来检查请求配置如何影响对一个文档的多重判断 。

blocks.en: Prompt studies reveal sensitivity to demonstration order and meaning-preserving formatting ( Lu et al., 2022 ; Sclar et al., 2024 ) . Batch prompting examines efficiency and positional effects across jointly requested examples ( Cheng et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) ; related work varies evidence location and answer-option order ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) . Our controls vary visible hypotheses, requested outputs, and output order while holding the contract and target fixed. CheckList motivates behavioral analysis beyond average accuracy ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ) , and order-consistent scoring shows that similar ranking quality can coexist with different decisions ( Frohmann et al., 2026 ) . We distinguish corrections, regressions, persistent errors, and variation across repeats under unchanged conditions.
blocks.zh: 即时研究揭示了对演示顺序和保留意义格式的敏感性(Lu等人,2022年;Sclar等人,2024年)。 批次提示审查联合请求实例的效率和位置效应(Cheng等人,2023年;Lin等人,2024年);相关工作不同证据位置和答案选择令(Liu等人,2024年;Zheng等人,2024年)。 我们的控制在维持合同和目标时,有不同的明显假设、要求的产出和产出顺序。 CheckList激励行为分析超越平均准确度(Ribeiro等人,2020年),订单一致的评分显示,类似的排名质量可以与不同决定共存(Frohmann等人,2026年). 我们区分更正、回归、持续错误和在不变条件下重复的各种差异。

blocks.en: HELM jointly evaluates quality, robustness, and efficiency ( Liang et al., 2023 ) , while model routing studies accuracy–cost trade-offs ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Ong et al., 2025 ) . We compare individual configurations with explicit costs and invalid-response accounting, connecting average correctness to whether fixed judgments remain correct across repeated conditions. Appendix H details these comparisons and additional legal, prompting, and evaluation literature.
blocks.zh: HELM联合评价质量、稳健性和效率(Liang等人,2023年),而模型路线研究精确性-成本权衡 (Chen等人,2024年;Ong等人,2025年). 我们把单个配置与明确的成本和无效反应核算进行比较,将平均正确性与固定判断是否仍然正确联系起来。 附 录 H详细列出了这些比较以及更多的法律、提示和评价文献。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Cost, response time, average accuracy, and persistent correctness describe complementary aspects of contract inference. Jev has the lowest cost and median baseline response time among the evaluated configurations, while hosted language models achieve higher baseline accuracy. Gemini Pro and Sonnet have the highest baseline and all-twelve-correct point estimates, respectively. Jev is competitive on repeated-condition correctness, but the small anchor panel does not establish a general stability advantage. The cost frontier remains specific to the evaluated configurations and prices.
blocks.zh: 成本、反应时间、平均准确性和持续正确性是合同推断的互补方面。 Jev在被评价的配置中成本最低,响应时间中位数最低,而主机语言模型则实现了更高的基准精度. 双子座Pro和Sonnet分别拥有最高基线和全十二正确点估计. Jev在重复条件正确性上具有竞争力,但小锚板并没有建立一般的稳定优势. 成本前沿仍然与评价的配置和价格具体有关。

blocks.en: Decision-level analysis explains these distinctions. On identical targets, similar mean correctness can coexist with different numbers of judgments that remain correct throughout. Corrections and regressions can cancel each other out in aggregate accuracy, while agreement can preserve errors. Even optimistically completing truncated answers leaves both Qwen configurations below Flash-Lite in baseline accuracy and below Jev in all-twelve correctness. Reporting correctness, direction of change, and validity alongside expenditure thus clarifies the observed trade-offs.
blocks.zh: 决策层面的分析解释了这些区别。 在相同的目标上,类似的平均正确性可以与始终正确的不同数量的判决共存。 校正和回归可以以总的准确性相互取消,而协议可以保存错误. 即使乐观地完成截断的回答,Qwen配置在基线精确度上都低于Flash-Lite,在全十二正确度上都低于Jev. 报告正确性、变化方向和有效性以及支出,从而澄清了观察到的权衡。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The official test contains 123 contracts and a stability subset of 30 contract targets, all drawn from the same 17 hypothesis types. The development analyses use 30 contracts for grouping experiments and ten different contracts for anchor controls. These samples limit generalization to other legal questions and domains. We use existing annotations without a human performance comparison, new adjudication, or external-domain validation. An official held-out split does not establish absence from model training data.
blocks.zh: 正式测试包含123项合同和30项合同目标的稳定性子集,均来自相同的17种假设类型。 开发分析采用30项组合试验合同和10项锚控制合同。 这些样本将一般化局限于其他法律问题和领域。 我们使用现有的说明,不进行人类性能比较,新的判断,或外部域验证. 官方的搁置并不证明缺乏示范培训数据。

blocks.en: The two principal quality measures use different target sets: baseline accuracy spans every contract–hypothesis pair, whereas all-twelve correctness concerns one anchor in each selected contract. Ranking differences can therefore reflect both target composition and sensitivity to the tested conditions. Three repeats provide limited information about possible responses, and bootstrap intervals may degenerate when no changes are observed. The small stability panel makes rankings sensitive to a few targets. Its intervals and paired comparisons are descriptive and not corrected for multiple testing.
blocks.zh: 两项主要的质量衡量标准采用不同的指标:基线精确度跨每份合同的假说对,而全部正确度涉及每份选定合同中一个锚。 因此,排名差异既可反映目标构成,也可反映对试验条件的敏感性。 三次重复提供的关于可能反应的信息有限,如果没有观察到变化,靴子间隔可能会恶化。 小的稳定面板使排名对少数目标敏感. 它的间隔和配对比较是描述性的,对于多次测试没有纠正.

blocks.en: Inference settings, interfaces, instruction wording, hardware, providers, and collection times differ across models. Hosted models may change behind a fixed identifier. Jev’s question-key ordering differs from autoregressive output ordering. The Qwen development comparison changes reasoning, temperature, and generation allowance together, so it cannot isolate the effect of reasoning alone. Nor does a common token limit equalize realized computation. Budget-exhausted answers are failures of the evaluated configuration, rather than evidence that a task is intrinsically beyond the model.
blocks.zh: 推论设置,界面,指令措辞,硬件,提供者,以及收藏时间在不同的模型中有所不同. 主机模型可能会在固定标识符后面改变. Jev的提问键命令不同于自动递归输出命令. Quen的开发比较会一起改变推理,温度,和生成的允许性,因此不能单独孤立推理的效果. 共同符号限制也不等于已实现计算。 预算耗尽的答案是评估配置的失败,而不是证明一项任务本质上超出了模型.

blocks.en: Costs follow the calculation in Section 3 . Local GPU costs use a declared rental equivalent. Local estimates exclude loading, idle allocation, and other non-inference expenditure, and do not measure cloud throughput. Latency includes infrastructure and network effects. The frontier may change under other prices, serving methods, or reasoning budgets.
blocks.zh: 费用按照第3节计算。 当地GPU费用使用申报的租金等价. 当地估算不包括加载,闲置分配等非推算支出,不计量云吞吐量. 延迟包括基础设施和网络效应。 根据其他价格、使用方法或推理预算,边界可能会发生变化。

blocks.en: Latency comparisons use one client but different collection times, providers, routes, and inference settings, with uncontrolled provider caching. Small differences in client-side preparation also remain. They cannot isolate architecture-level efficiency, separate computation from network and queueing delays, or establish throughput under concurrent load.
blocks.zh: 即时比较使用一个客户端但不同的收集时间,提供者,路径,和推论设置,无控制提供者缓存. 在客户方准备方面也存在小的差别。 它们不能隔离架构层面的效率,不能从网络和排队延迟中分离计算,也不能在同时负载下确定吞吐量.

blocks.en: The model comparison developed in stages: Sonnet, Haiku, and Terra were added after earlier results were inspected. Their predictions use fixed task and scoring rules, but model selection itself is exploratory. All ten test stability evaluations are complete; historical Astra development anchor coverage remains incomplete and is analyzed separately. Broader evidence would be required to assess suitability for legal practice or financial decision-making.
blocks.zh: 分阶段开发的模型比较:Sonnet、Haiku和Terra在检查了早先的结果后被添加。 他们的预测使用固定的任务和评分规则,但模型选择本身是探索性的. 所有10个测试稳定性评价都已完成;历史的Astra开发主锚覆盖范围仍然不完整,并单独分析。 评估是否适合法律实践或财务决策需要更广泛的证据。

blocks.en: Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: We use ContractNLI under its stated CC BY 4.0 license and retain attribution to its creators. The study uses existing data and annotations, with no new personal-data collection or human participation. Examples retain their dataset identifiers and original labels. Any redistribution should preserve attribution and licensing while minimizing additional identifying information. The evaluation concerns model behavior in a research setting. Incorrect or unstable judgments could cause harm if treated as professional legal or financial determinations.
blocks.zh: 我们使用ContractNLI, 该研究使用现有数据和说明,没有新的个人数据收集或人类参与。 实例保留其数据集标识符和原始标签。 任何再分配都应保留归属和许可证,同时尽量减少更多的识别信息。 评价涉及研究环境中的模型行为。 如果将不正确或不稳定的判决视为专业法律或财务决定,则可能造成伤害。

blocks.en: The class recalls expose error profiles that overall accuracy obscures. Jev has the highest observed contradiction recall, Astra the highest entailment recall, and Sonnet the highest not-mentioned recall. These descriptive comparisons concern classes with unequal support; they do not establish significant differences between models.
blocks.zh: 该类回顾暴露出总体准确性模糊的错误剖面. 捷夫有最高观察到的矛盾召回,Astra是最高的召回,索内是最高的未提及召回. 这些描述性比较涉及支持不平等的类别;它们没有确立模型之间的重大差异。

blocks.en: Jev correctly classifies 170 of 220 contradictions, whereas Gemini Pro correctly classifies 135. Relative to Jev, Gemini Pro gains 47 correct entailments and 110 correct not-mentioned labels but loses 35 correct contradictions, producing its net gain of 122 correct judgments. Overall accuracy weights class-specific recall by class support. These counts do not establish an application-specific preference without an independently justified valuation of the errors.
blocks.zh: Jev将220个矛盾中的170个正确分类,而双子座Pro将135个正确分类. 与Jev相比,双子座Pro获得了47个更正内涵和110个未提及更正的标签,但损失了35个正确矛盾,产生了122个正确判断的净收益. 总体精度按类支持进行类特定召回加权. 如果对错误不作独立合理的估价,这些计数不能确定具体应用的优先性。

blocks.en: Qwen9B illustrates how similar condition-level scores can conceal changes at the target level. Each condition yields 71 or 72 correct answers among 90 intended judgments, yet eight targets receive different valid labels across the twelve responses. Two more targets encounter generation-budget exhaustion, and two repeat the same wrong label throughout. The remaining eighteen are correct in every response. Invalid answers count as incorrect and prevent all-twelve correctness, but supply no observed label for the change-rate calculation.
blocks.zh: Quen9B说明了类似条件级的分数如何可以隐藏目标级的变化. 每个条件在90项判决中得出71或72项正确答案,然而,在12项答复中,有8项目标得到了不同的有效标签。 另外两个目标遇到生成预算耗尽,两个目标在整个过程中重复同样的错误标签。 其余18个答复是正确的。 无效的答案计数为不正确,并阻止全十二正确性,但是没有为变化率计算提供可观察到的标签.

blocks.en: Appendix B Development Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 附录B 诊断

blocks.en: The development experiments clarify how request factors and outcome categories affect the interpretation of model performance. They include earlier diagnostics that motivated the test design, but use different samples, prompts, and inference configurations. We therefore preserve their results as a separate analysis, detailed in Appendices C – E .
blocks.zh: 开发实验澄清了请求因素和结果类别如何影响模型性能的解释. 它们包括早期的诊断,激发测试设计,但使用不同的样本,提示和推论配置. 因此,我们保留了单独分析的结果,详见附录C-E。

blocks.en: On 30 development contracts, Qwen4B changes 87 of 510 labels between joint and single-hypothesis requests, but the number correct changes by only four. The changes comprise 38 regressions, 34 corrections, and 15 switches between wrong labels. Aggregate accuracy therefore understates the number of decisions affected by grouping.
blocks.zh: 在30个开发合同中,Quen4B在联合和单声道请求之间更改了510个标签中的87个,但数字正确的更改只有4个. 这些变化包括38个回归、34个更正和15个在错误标签之间的开关。 因此,总体准确性低估了分组决定的数量。

blocks.en: In the disjoint development anchor panel, Qwen4B has the same A and B accuracy, yet 24 of 90 paired responses change: 12 regressions and 12 corrections. The requested answer set is fixed, and every anchor has the same answer across unchanged repeats within each arm. Figure 1 shows one regression. This example motivates separating visible questions from the number of requested answers.
blocks.zh: 在脱节开发主板中,Quen4B有相同的A和B精度,然而90对响应中的24对变化:12对回归和12对修正. 请求的答案集是固定的,每个主播对每个臂内不变的重复都有相同的答案. 图1显示一个回归情况。 这个例子促使人们将可见问题与所请求的答案数量区分开来.

blocks.en: A separate paired development comparison changes the Qwen configurations from thinking disabled with a 2,048-token allowance to thinking enabled with a 32,768-token allowance, also changing temperature and sampling. Mean anchor correctness rises from 76.67% to 81.11% for Qwen4B and from 74.17% to 82.50% for Qwen9B, but their all-twelve-correct counts change from 17 to 17 and from 16 to 18, respectively. Recorded completion-token use increases by 68.30 and 63.51 times. Both paired intervals for the all-twelve change include zero. Additional generation can thus accompany higher average correctness without a comparably clear gain in persistent correctness. This is a comparison of complete configurations, not an isolated reasoning ablation; Appendix K reports the paired results.
blocks.zh: 单独对齐的开发比较会改变Quen的配置,从2 048个托肯津贴的思维障碍转变为32 768个托肯津贴的思维障碍,也改变温度和抽样。 Quen4B的平均锚正确度从76.67%上升到81.11%,Quen9B的平均锚正确度从74.17%上升到82.50%,但其全部正确计数分别从17到17和16到18. 记录的完成式使用增加了68.30倍和63.51倍. 全十二变的双对间隔均包括0. 因此,额外的生成可以伴随较高的平均正确性,而不会在持久性正确性方面获得相当明确的收益。 这是对完整配置的比较,而不是孤立的推理衰减;附录K报告了配对结果.

blocks.en: Appendix C Development Data and Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录C 数据和协议

blocks.en: C.1 Data and sampling
blocks.zh: C.1 数据和取样

blocks.en: The development evaluation uses ContractNLI’s annotated contract–hypothesis decisions ( Koreeda and Manning, 2021 ) . We sort development documents by integer ID and sample 30 without replacement using seed 20260920. Each example retains the full contract text, all 17 original hypotheses, and the original class annotations. Evidence spans are excluded from model inputs, and sampling is independent of model predictions.
blocks.zh: 开发评价采用ContractNLI附加说明的合同-伪证决定(Koreeda and Manning, 2021). 我们用整数的ID和样本 30来整理开发文件 而不用20260920种子来替换 每个例子都保留了合同全文,全部17个原始假设,以及原始的类说明. 模型输入中不包括证据跨度,取样独立于模型预测.

blocks.en: The sampled 510 targets comprise 280 entailments, 48 contradictions, and 182 not-mentioned labels, motivating class-level reporting alongside overall accuracy. Each experimental condition partitions the same hypotheses into request groups. We match predictions by document and hypothesis before paired analysis. The five-contract panel uses the first five documents in the randomized sample.
blocks.zh: 所抽样的510项目标包括280项内含物、48项矛盾和182项未提及的标签,促使在整体准确性的同时进行分类报告。 每个实验条件将相同的假设分割成请求组. 在对齐分析之前,我们通过文件和假设来匹配预测。 五合同小组在随机抽样中使用前五份文件。

blocks.en: We independently recompute scores and transitions from individual predictions, verifying that paired observations share the same targets and gold labels. All three pilot phases have complete prediction coverage; Appendix F gives the document selection and sample sizes. Scores measure agreement with the original annotations, whose legal interpretations may remain ambiguous in individual cases.
blocks.zh: 我们独立地从个人预测中重新计算分数和过渡,核实对等观测结果具有相同的目标和金色标签. 所有三个试验阶段都有完整的预测范围;附录F给出了文件选择和样本大小. 得分计量协议与原说明一致,其法律解释在个别案件中可能仍然含糊不清.

blocks.en: C.2 Models and inference settings
blocks.zh: C.2 模型和推论设置

blocks.en: The development baseline compares Jev 1.13.0, Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Sonnet 5, and Claude Haiku 4.5. Jev receives the contract as shared state and each hypothesis as a native Choice question. Generative models receive structured classification instructions and return a JSON label map. Task instructions are semantically aligned across these model-specific interfaces.
blocks.zh: 开发基线比较了Jev 1.13.0,Quen3.5-4B和9B,双子座3.1 Pro预览,双子座3.5 Flash-Lite,GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra,GPT-6 Astra,克劳德·索内5和克劳德·海库4.5. Jev作为共享状态接收合同,每个假说作为本土选择问题. 基因模型收到结构化的分类说明,并返回一个JSON标签图. 任务指令在这些模型特定界面之间有紧密的对接.

blocks.en: In the initial baseline, grouping, and anchor experiments, the Qwen models use BF16, disabled thinking, and temperature zero. Gemini Pro uses low thinking, Flash-Lite minimal thinking, Luna no reasoning, and Astra high reasoning. Luna and Astra are accessed through OpenRouter, with OpenAI identified as the provider for the initial pilot. Reasoning budgets differ across models, and actual reasoning length can vary within a setting: all 30 Astra baseline responses contain reasoning tokens, totaling 23,042.
blocks.zh: 在初始基线,分组,以及锚定实验中,Quen模型使用BF16,残障思维,温度0. 双子座Pro采用低思考,Flash-Lite最低思考,Luna无推理,Astra高推理. Luna和Astra通过OpenRouter访问,OpenAI被确定为初始飞行员的提供者. 不同模型的理性预算不同,实际推理长度在一个设定中可能有所不同:所有30个Astra基线答复都包含推理符号,总计23,042.

blocks.en: The later development extension adds Terra, Sonnet, and Haiku with the same inference settings used in their test evaluations: medium reasoning for Terra, adaptive thinking with medium effort for Sonnet, and disabled thinking for Haiku. Terra and Sonnet permit 16,384 output tokens; Haiku permits 8,192. All three use the Convert gateway. Gemini Pro’s extended controls retain its original low-thinking configuration. The new GPT-6 controls use high reasoning through Convert, which identifies the model as GPT-6; the earlier baseline uses GPT-6 Astra through OpenRouter. We keep these controls separate because the two routes are not assumed to serve an identical checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 后期的开发扩展增加了Terra,Sonnet,和Haiku在测试评价中使用的相同推论设置:Terra的中推理,Sonnet的中努力的适应性思维,和Haiku的残疾思维. Terra和Sonnet允许16,384个输出符;Haiku允许8,192个. 三者皆使用转换网关. 双子座Pro的扩展控制保留了最初的低思考配置. 新的GPT-6控制通过转换使用高推理,将模型识别为GPT-6;早期的基准通过OpenRouter使用GPT-6 Astra. 我们保持这些控制是分开的,因为这两条路线被认为不会为同一个检查站服务。

blocks.en: C.3 Experimental conditions
blocks.zh: C.3 实验条件

blocks.en: The initial baseline evaluates seven models on the same 30 contracts, with one K = 17 K=17 request per contract. Ninety observations for Jev, Gemini Pro, and Qwen4B come from an earlier collection, followed by evaluation of the other four models. Collection times therefore differ. For the earlier observations, request duration serves as a proxy for document completion time where the latter was not measured separately.

blocks.en: All seven models are then evaluated under seven conditions on the common five-contract subset. The same conditions are applied to Jev, the two Qwen models, Flash-Lite, and Luna on all 30 contracts. This expansion reuses the development sample after exploratory inspection. Each sensitivity comparison uses the K = 17 K=17 baseline from its own experimental phase.

blocks.zh: 在检查了早期的发展和测试结果之后,我们用同样的合同、提示和标签来扩展发展比较。 Sonnet,Terra,和Haiku各获得K=17K=17的基线,一个不变的重复,以及所有30个合同的1个通量. 每个模型的基线都支持成本准确性比较及其配对控制。 双子座Pro和GPT-6在单独的新集中获得相同的三个条件. 它们的控制使用这些新匹配的基线,而图4则保留了较早的双子Pro和OpenRouter GPT-6 Astra基线. 每一份比较都会在一个收集和路线内将响应对齐. 延期包括450项关于这5个小组的请求和1 080项关于三个新主播评价的请求,没有较小小组或货币条件。 模型选择仍然是探索性的;样本、推论设置和评分规则在这些额外请求之前是固定的。

blocks.en: Dependence among NLP observations matters for statistical evaluation ( Dror et al., 2018 ) . Zero observed changes can yield a degenerate interval despite uncertainty about the underlying change probability. Latency is the median elapsed time required to obtain all requested decisions for a document, including concurrent execution where applicable. API costs use provider-reported charges or recorded token usage priced at public rates. These timings combine model inference, network latency, scheduling, caching, and provider infrastructure.

blocks.en: D.1 Correctness and sensitivity are distinct
blocks.zh: D.1 正确性和敏感性各不相同

blocks.en: Jev achieves 77.06% accuracy, while Gemini Pro has the highest observed accuracy (82.94%) and Macro-F1 (77.19%) among the ten development baselines (Table 7 ). The added Terra, Sonnet, and Haiku baselines achieve 81.76%, 81.37%, and 78.82% accuracy, respectively. At the stated prices, none extends the observed cost–accuracy frontier formed by Jev, Qwen4B, Flash-Lite, and Gemini Pro. Both the contracts and Qwen inference configurations differ between the development and test comparisons, preventing attribution of their frontier differences to either factor alone.
blocks.zh: Jev的精度达到77.06%,而双子座Pro在十个发展基线中观测到的精度最高(82.94%)和Macro-F1(77.19%)(表7)。 增加的Terra、Sonnet和Haiku基线分别达到81.76%、81.37%和78.82%的准确度。 由Jev、Quen4B、Flash-Lite和双子座Pro组成的精确边界。 合同和Quen推论的配置在发展与测试比较之间都不同,因此无法将其前沿差异单独归结为两个因素。

blocks.en: Similar aggregate accuracy can accompany substantial changes in individual judgments (Table 8 ). In the five-model comparison, Qwen4B changes 87/510 labels when moving from joint K = 17 K=17 inference to K = 1 K=1 , but the number correct changes only from 399 to 395. These transitions comprise 38 regressions, 34 corrections, and 15 switches between wrong labels. Flash-Lite and Luna both change 68 labels, although their net numbers correct change by minus five and plus one. For Qwen9B, reordering the K = 17 K=17 hypotheses changes 51 labels while reducing the number correct by one.
blocks.zh: 在个别判决发生重大变化时,同样的总体准确性也会随之而来(表8)。 在五模式比较中,Quen4B在从联合K=17K=17推论转换为K=1K=1时会改变87/510标签,但数字正确变化仅从399改为395. 这些转换包括38个回归、34个更正和15个错误标签之间的开关。 Flash-Lite和Luna都更改了68个标签,尽管其净数正确更改为负5和+1. 对于Quen9B,重排K = 17 K = 17 假说修改了51个标签,同时将数字正确减少一个.

blocks.en: Finding 1: Aggregate correctness can conceal substantial changes to individual decisions. Across local and hosted generative models, corrections and regressions partly cancel in accuracy. Their separate counts distinguish beneficial changes from newly introduced errors.
blocks.zh: 查找 1: 总体正确性可以掩盖个别决定的重大改变。 在局部和托管的基因模型中,校正和回归部分取消了准确性。 它们的单独计数将有益的变化与新引入的错误区分开来.

blocks.en: Table 8: Development-set sensitivity to judgment-set size, order, and repetition on 30 contracts. Accuracy is reported in percentages; flip counts use 510 paired targets. Each model is compared with its own K = 17 K{=}17 baseline. The final column decomposes the K = 17 → 1 K{=}17\to 1 transitions, where C/W denotes correctness rather than entailment class. Order and Repeat each represent one perturbation.
blocks.zh: 表8:对30份合同的判断设定大小、订单和重复的开发敏感性。 准确性按百分比报告;翻转计数使用510对对目标。 每个模型与自己的K = 17 KQQ17基线进行对比. 最后一栏将 K = 17 = ~ 1 K = 17\\\ = 切换到 1 个过渡,其中 C/W 表示正确性而非必然类. 顺序和重复每个代表一个扰动。

blocks.en: D.2 Repetition and class effects matter
blocks.zh: D.2 重复和类效应事项

blocks.en: Jev shows few changes under grouping and permutation, but unchanged repetition also changes some labels. It changes 6/510 labels for K ​ 17 → K ​ 1 K17\to K1 , eight under permutation, and four under unchanged repetition (Figure 5 , Appendix G ). All four targets that change under repetition also change under grouping and permutation, making repeat variability relevant to both comparisons. Each control has only one realization; subtracting the repeat count would therefore not isolate a grouping or order effect.
blocks.zh: Jev在分组和演化下显示很少变化,但不变的重复也会改变一些标签. 它修改了K 17 → K 1 K17\to K1的6/510标签,8个在通缩下,4个在不变的重复下(图5,附录G)。 重复变化的所有四个目标也在分组和布局下发生变化,使重复变化与两个比较都相关。 每个控件只有一个实现;因此,减去重复计数不会孤立组合或顺序效应.

blocks.en: Qwen4B and Qwen9B show no label changes in their one unchanged repeat, while their K K and order comparisons change many targets. Flash-Lite and Luna show 16 and 14 repeat changes respectively; their order comparisons each change 30 targets. Of Flash-Lite’s 68 K K changes, nine targets also change in the repeat; Luna’s overlap is seven. These observations show different sensitivity profiles within the sampled requests.
blocks.zh: Quen4B 和 Quen9 数据 B在它们一个不变的重复中显示没有标签更改,而它们的K K和顺序比较会改变许多目标. Flash-Lite和Luna分别显示16和14个重复变化;它们的命令比较每个变化30个目标. Flash-Lite的68 K K变化中,9个目标也改变重复;Luna的重叠为7个. 这些观测显示,在抽样请求中,敏感度分布不同。

blocks.en: Low observed sensitivity is not specific to Jev. In the five-contract comparison (Appendix G ), Astra changes only 1/85 labels for K ​ 17 → K ​ 1 K17\to K1 and none under permutation or repetition. Gemini Pro changes 6/85 in each of these three comparisons. This evidence comes from a smaller sample than the 30-contract expansion.
blocks.zh: 低观测灵敏度不特指Jev. 在五份合同比较(附录G)中,Astra只更改了K 17 → K 1 K17\\ to K1的1/85标签,没有改动或重复。 双子座Pro在这三种比较中分别改变6/85. 这一证据来自一个比30份合同扩展更小的样本。

blocks.en: The extended 30-contract controls broaden this comparison (Figure 5 ). GPT-6 through Convert changes 4/510 labels under both unchanged repetition and permutation. Sonnet changes 15 and 29, Haiku 25 and 42, Terra 33 and 37, and Gemini Pro 28 and 44, respectively. All pairs are valid, and each control is matched to a baseline from the same collection. The new GPT-6 observations remain separate from the historical Astra route. Thus, a generative model also has low observed change rates, while several other configurations show material variation under unchanged requests.
blocks.zh: 延长的30项合同控制扩大了这一比较(图5)。 GPT-6通过转换 4/510 标签在不变的重复和穿透下. Sonnet分别改变15和29,海库25和42,Terra33和37,双子座Pro28和44. 所有对子都是有效的,每个控件都与同一集合的基线匹配. 新的GPT-6观测仍与历史的Astra路线分开. 因此,基因模型的观测变化率也很低,而其他几个配置则在未改变的要求下显示出物质变化。

blocks.en: Finding 2: Sensitivity must be interpreted alongside repeat variability and sample size. Agreement over a finite set of repeats describes observed behavior; it does not establish deterministic behavior.
blocks.zh: 查找 2:必须结合重复的变异性和样本大小来解释敏感性。 对有限重复的约定描述了观察到的行为;它没有确立决定性的行为。

blocks.en: Grouping can improve one label class while damaging another. For Qwen4B, moving to K = 1 K=1 improves contradiction recall from 16/48 to 28/48, while entailment and not-mentioned recall decrease. Accuracy falls slightly, but Macro-F1 rises from 66.39% to 70.96%. Of its 24 not-mentioned-to-contradiction transitions, 16 correct a contradiction target, five damage a not-mentioned target, and three switch between wrong labels on entailment targets.
blocks.zh: 分组可以改善一个标签类,同时损害另一个标签类. 对于Qwen4B,移动到K = 1 K = 1会改善矛盾的召回,从16/48到28/48,同时引起和未提及的召回减少. 准确度略有下降,但Macro-F1从66.39%上升到70.96%. 其24个未提及到的过渡中,16个纠正了一个矛盾的目标,5个损坏了一个未提及的目标,3个在引致目标上错标的切换.

blocks.en: Luna shows a complementary trade-off. Its entailment recall decreases from 261/280 to 237/280, while contradiction recall rises from 34/48 to 41/48 and not-mentioned recall from 106/182 to 124/182. The class changes are minus 24, plus seven, and plus 18 correct decisions, leaving a net gain of only one. Its Macro-F1 increases from 71.39% to 73.66%. For Flash-Lite, 31 transitions go from entailment to not mentioned: 18 are regressions, 11 corrections, and two switches between wrong labels. Appendix G gives the complete class recalls.
blocks.zh: 露娜表现出了互补的取舍. 它的召回从261/280减少到237/280,自相矛盾的召回从34/48增加到41/48,未提及召回从106/182增加到124/182。 班次变化为负24,加7,加18个正确的决定,只留下一个净收益. 其宏F1从71.39%增加到73.66%. 对于Flash-Lite,31个过渡从内涵到未提及:18个是回归,11个更正,两个开关在错误的标签之间. 附 录 G给全课的回顾。

blocks.en: Specific hypotheses account for substantial fractions of the observed regressions and improvements. The copying-permission hypothesis, nda-17, changes in 18/30 contracts for Qwen4B and 13/30 for Qwen9B under K ​ 17 → K ​ 1 K17\to K1 ; 12 changes are regressions in each model. Luna’s return-or-destruction hypothesis, nda-16, changes in 16/30 contracts, including 11 corrections. These patterns localize the changes beyond the class-level counts.
blocks.zh: 具体的假设是所观察到的倒退和改良的很大一部分。 复制-许可假说nda-17,K17 → K1 K17\to K1下18/30合同的Quen4B和Qwen9B的13/30变更;12个变更是每个模型的回归. 卢娜的回归或毁灭假说nda-16,16/30合同的变化,包括11个更正. 这些模式将超出类数的变化本地化.

blocks.en: Finding 3: Grouping changes can redistribute errors across classes and hypotheses. A model can gain balanced class performance while losing overall accuracy.
blocks.zh: 发现3:分组变化可以将错误在类别和假设中重新分配. 一个模型可以在失去整体准确性的同时获得平衡的班级性能.

blocks.en: D.3 Separating request factors
blocks.zh: D.3 请求分离因素

blocks.en: The pilot links request configuration to changes in predictions, but its grouping comparison varies several factors together: the number of visible hypotheses, the required output structure, the amount and order of generated text, and the number of requests. Permutation likewise changes hypothesis order and JSON-property order together. Jev also differs from the autoregressive models in its native Choice interface and instruction wording. These coupled factors motivate the comparisons in Appendix E , which vary visibility and requested output separately.
blocks.zh: 试运行将请求配置与预测的变化联系起来,但其分组比较将几个因素放在一起:可见假说的数量,所需的输出结构,生成文本的数量和顺序,以及请求的数量. 永久性同样会同时改变假说顺序和JSON财产顺序. Jev在其本土选择界面和指令措辞中也不同于自递模式. 这些连带因素促使在附录E中进行比较,这种比较的能见度不同,要求的产出也不同。

blocks.en: Concurrency addresses a separate efficiency question. Comparing K ​ 1 , c ​ 1 K1,c1 with K ​ 1 , c ​ 4 K1,c4 reduces median document completion time to 27.5–37.6% of its serial value across the five core models. This total latency reduction includes network, caching, and scheduling effects. The fixed K = 1 K=1 setting separates the concurrency comparison from changes in grouping. Appendix G reports the corresponding paired label changes.
blocks.zh: 货币处理的是另一个效率问题。 将K 1,c 1 K1,c1与K 1,c 4 K1,c4相比较,将中间文件完成时间减少到5个核心模型序列值的27.5-37.6%. 这种暂时性的总减少包括网络、缓存和排程效应。 固定的 K = 1 K = 1 设置将货币比较与分组变化区分开来. 附 录 G报告相应的配对标签更改.

blocks.en: Appendix E Development Visibility and Output Controls
blocks.zh: 附录E 发展可见度和输出控制

blocks.en: E.1 Controlled comparison
blocks.zh: E.1 联合国 控制比较

blocks.en: The follow-up comparison fixes the sample and experimental conditions before inference. Ten contracts are sampled from the 31 development documents outside the pilot, with seed 20260921. Three distinct hypotheses per contract are selected uniformly with document-specific seeds, independently of gold labels and model predictions. The 30 anchors contain 12 entailments, three contradictions, and 15 not-mentioned labels. The follow-up and pilot samples are disjoint within this study; their possible inclusion in model training data is unknown.
blocks.zh: 后续比较在推论前先确定样本和实验条件. 从试点外的31份开发文件中抽查出10份合同,种子20260921. 每个合同有三种不同的假设,与文件特有的种子一致选择,独立于金色标签和模型预测. 30个主播包含12个内涵,3个矛盾,15个未提及标签. 后续和试点样本在本研究中脱节;它们可能列入示范培训数据的情况不详。

blocks.en: Jev, Qwen3.5-4B, and Flash-Lite each have valid predictions for 360/360 observations. Astra’s high-reasoning condition covers 293/360 observations under the prespecified spending rule; the remaining 67 are unobserved, and none of the collected responses failed. Appendix I.1 analyzes this unequal coverage separately. A subsequent evaluation adds Qwen9B with 360 valid responses (Appendix E.4 ). Each anchor–arm pair is evaluated three times, with request order randomized within each contract and concurrency one per model. The catalog prompt differs from the pilot, so comparisons between phases also reflect that change. Both Qwen models use a 2,048 output-token cap in every arm, with thinking disabled and temperature zero. Unqualified Qwen results in this development section refer to Qwen4B.
blocks.zh: Jev, Quen3.5-4B,和Flash-Lite各有360/360观测的有效预测. Astra的高合理性条件包括预先规定的支出规则下的293/360观察;其余67个没有被观察到,所收集的答复都没有失败。 附录一.1分别分析了这种不平等的覆盖面。 之后的评价增加了Qwen9B,并附有360个有效回应(附录E.4 . 每对锚-臂对进行3次评估,在每份合同中将请求顺序随机排列,每个模型1个货币。 目录提示符与飞行员不同,因此不同阶段之间的比较也反映了这种变化. 两个Quen模型在每个臂部都使用2,048个输出托肯盖,思维障碍和温度0. 本开发部分无资格的Quen结果参考Quen4B.

blocks.en: The four arms retain the contract and original anchor label: A. Only the anchor is visible; only its label is requested. B. All 17 hypotheses are visible in their original order; only the anchor label is requested. C. The same catalog is visible; all 17 labels are requested, anchor first. D. The same catalog is visible; all 17 labels are requested, anchor last. The contract and visible catalog are identical across B/C/D; only the required outputs differ. A–B varies visible hypotheses with the requested label set fixed; B–C varies output workload and structure at fixed visible content; C–D varies requested output order and structure. These interventions separate observable prompt factors, while the models’ internal decision processes remain unobserved.
blocks.zh: 这四件武器保留了合同和原锚标签: A类. 只可见锚;只要求其标签. B. 所有17种假设按原顺序可见;只要求锚标签. 丙.. 相同的目录是可见的;所有17个标签都是要求的,首先主播. D类. 相同的目录可见;所有17个标签都被请求,最后锁定. 整个B/C/D的合同和可见目录相同;只有所需产出不同。 A–B在所请求的标签设定固定的情况下,可以有不同的可见假说; B–C在固定可见内容下可以有不同的输出工作量和结构; C–D在所请求的输出顺序和结构上可以有不同. 这些干预措施将可观察到的迅速因素分开,而模型的内部决策程序则仍然不受观察。

blocks.en: Only the anchor is visible; only its label is requested.
blocks.zh: 只可见锚;只要求其标签.

blocks.en: All 17 hypotheses are visible in their original order; only the anchor label is requested.
blocks.zh: 所有17种假说按原顺序可见;只要求锚标签.

blocks.en: The same catalog is visible; all 17 labels are requested, anchor first.
blocks.zh: 相同的目录是可见的;所有17个标签都是要求的,首先主播.

blocks.en: The same catalog is visible; all 17 labels are requested, anchor last.
blocks.zh: 相同的目录可见;所有17个标签都被请求,最后锁定.

blocks.en: Jev represents hypotheses through shared state and native Choice questions, so C/D changes the order of its question keys. For autoregressive models, the same contrast changes the requested sequence of generated answers. Both Qwen models and Flash-Lite follow the required order in every valid response, as assessed from the original output sequence. Restricting their valid paired predictions to responses with the required order therefore leaves the label-change rates unchanged. This observed output order need not correspond to internal reasoning order.
blocks.zh: Jev通过共享状态和本地选择问题来代表假设,因此C/D改变其提问键的顺序. 对于自动递归模型,相同的对比会改变所请求的生成答案的顺序. Quen模型和Flash-Lite都按照从原始输出序列评估出的每个有效响应中所需的顺序. 因此,限制其有效配对预测与所需顺序的对应,使标签变化率保持不变。 观察到的输出顺序不需要与内部推理顺序对应.

blocks.en: Primary scoring evaluates the preselected anchor in each response, yielding 90 observations per arm from 30 anchors evaluated three times. Transitions pair observations by contract, anchor, and replicate, while repeat disagreement compares all three replicate pairs per anchor. A stable-correct anchor matches its fixed gold label in all four conditions and all three repeats: all twelve predictions must be correct. The stable-correct rate divides the number of such anchors by all 30 selected anchors. Strict stability instead requires a valid, identical label across all twelve observations. It therefore also includes stable-wrong anchors, whose identical predictions are incorrect. Intervals resample whole contracts (5,000 draws, seed 20260921), preserving the ten document clusters underlying the 360 repeated observations.
blocks.zh: 初级评分评价每个响应中预选的主播,从3次评价的30个主播中得出每臂90个观测结果. 过渡通过合同、锚和复制进行对对观测,而重复的分歧则比照每个锚的三个复制对。 一个稳定的正确锚在全部四个条件中都与其固定的金色标签匹配,所有三个重复:所有12个预测必须正确. 稳定正确率将这种锚数除以所有30个选定的锚数。 相反,严格稳定要求在所有12个观察中有一个有效、相同的标签。 因此,它还包括稳定错误锚,其同样的预测是不正确的。 Intervals 重新模拟整个合同(5 000笔抽取,种子20260921),保留360重复观察所依据的10个文件集群.

blocks.en: The development anchor tables include seven complete evaluations: Jev, Flash-Lite, both Qwen models, Terra, Sonnet, and Haiku. The last three models are added after inspection of the earlier results, using the same contracts, anchors, prompts, four conditions, and three repetitions. Appendix C describes their inference settings. All models share the same targets and scoring rules. Attempted requests without valid predictions count as incorrect in accuracy and prevent the affected anchor from satisfying strict stability; they are neither removed nor repeated. Paired label-change rates use only jointly valid predictions, with coverage reported separately.
blocks.zh: 开发主播表包括7个完整的评价:Jev,Flash-Lite,双昆模式,Terra,Sonnet,和Haiku. 后三种模式在检查前期结果后增加,采用相同的合同,锚,符,四个条件,重复三次. 附 录 C描述了它们的推论设置. 所有模型都具有相同的目标和评分规则. 未经有效预测就试图提出请求,其准确性不正确,使受影响的锚无法满足严格的稳定性;这些请求既未删除,也未重复。 保定标签变更率仅采用联合有效的预测,覆盖范围另行报告.

blocks.en: Table 9: Development anchor accuracy and repeat consistency for seven complete models: three fixed anchors in each of ten contracts, four conditions, and three repetitions. Accuracy uses only the anchor label, including in C/D. Repeat changes compare all three response pairs per anchor; these pairs are dependent. Invalid responses count wrong for accuracy and are excluded from changed-answer pairs. Both Qwen models disable thinking. Marks compare models within the same condition, not across conditions. ↑ \uparrow / ↓ \downarrow : higher/lower is better. Bold and underlining indicate the best and second-best distinct values, including ties, within each indicated comparison; these marks do not imply statistical significance.

blocks.en: Table 10: Development answer transitions matched by contract, anchor, and repetition. C/W denotes correct/wrong relative to the gold label. The W → \to W column counts changes between different wrong labels. These descriptive directions are not rankings; invalid pairs are excluded from change counts. For Jev, C/D changes native question order and does not establish autoregressive answer position.
blocks.zh: 表10:按合同、锚地和重复对等的发展答案过渡。 C/W表示相对于金色标签的正确/错误. W =\ to W 列计算不同错误标签之间的变化 。 这些描述性方向不是排名;无效对数被排除在变化计数之外. 对于Jev,C/D改变原生问题顺序,不建立自旋式回答位置.

blocks.en: E.2 Fixed accuracy, changed targets and class balance
blocks.zh: E.2 联合国 固定准确性、改变的目标和类余额

blocks.en: Expanding the visible catalog changes Qwen’s decisions even when the requested hypothesis and aggregate accuracy stay fixed. A and B each produce 69/90 correct predictions (76.67%), but 24/90 paired labels change: 12 correct-to-wrong and 12 wrong-to-correct. Every anchor receives the same label across repeats within each arm, so the transitions affect eight distinct anchors, four improved and four damaged. The descriptive contract-bootstrap 95% interval is 10.00–46.67% for the change rate and [ − 10.00 , 10.00 ] [-10.00,10.00] percentage points for the accuracy difference. All four Qwen arms show zero repeat disagreement. Figure 1 illustrates one regression. In this A/B comparison, the contract, output requirements, temperature, and token cap are fixed; only the visible hypothesis catalog varies.
blocks.zh: 扩展可见目录更改 Quen的决定即使要求的假设和总的准确性保持不变。 A和B各产生69/90的正确预测(76.67%),但24/90对的标签变化:12对错和12对错. 每个锚在每一臂内重复得到相同的标记,因此过渡会影响八个不同的锚,四个改进,四个损坏. 说明性合同-包干95%的间隔为10.00-46.67%的变动率,准确度差为[−10.00,10.00] [10.00,10.00]个百分点。 所有四支奎恩武器都显示零重复分歧. 图1显示了一种倒退。 在这个A/B比较中,合同,输出要求,温度,和令牌封顶是固定的;只有可见假说目录不同.

blocks.en: The unchanged accuracy also conceals a shift in class-level performance. Qwen’s Macro-F1 falls from 71.90% in A to 55.14% in B. Contradiction recall falls from 6/9 repeated predictions to 0/9, while entailment and not-mentioned recall improve. Those nine contradiction observations come from only three distinct anchors, leaving the magnitude of this class-specific change particularly uncertain.
blocks.zh: 不变的准确性也掩盖了班级性能的转变. Quen的Macro-F1从A的71.90%下降到B的55.14%。 矛盾性召回从6/9的重复预测下降到0/9,而必然和未提及的召回则有所改善。 这9个矛盾的观察只来自三个不同的锚点,使得这一阶级变化的规模特别不确定。

blocks.en: Jev’s A–B comparison changes 15/90 labels, including eight regressions, five corrections, and two switches between wrong labels. Flash-Lite changes 4/90, all regressions. This relative sensitivity differs from the pilot’s grouping comparison, indicating that the pattern depends on which aspect of the request changes.
blocks.zh: Jev的A-B比较会改变15/90标签,包括8个回归,5个更正,以及错误标签之间的两个开关. Flash-Lite改变4/90,所有回归. 这种相对的敏感性与飞行员的分组比较有所不同,表明模式取决于请求的哪个方面有所改变.

blocks.en: Finding 4: A single requested judgment can depend on other visible questions. Qwen’s A–B changes occur with a fixed requested answer set and agreement across unchanged repeats. This establishes catalog sensitivity within the ten-contract sample; its prevalence beyond that sample requires broader evaluation.
blocks.zh: 调查结果4:单一请求的判断可以取决于其他可见的问题. Quen的 A- B 变化会随着固定的答案集和一致的重复而发生。 这确定了十份合同样本内的目录敏感性;超出该样本范围的目录普遍程度需要更广泛的评价。

blocks.en: E.3 Output composition and stable errors
blocks.zh: E.3 联合国 产出构成和稳定错误

blocks.en: Some judgments also change with output workload or requested order at fixed catalog visibility. Qwen changes 3/90 labels for B–C and 15/90 for C–D; the latter comprises three regressions, nine corrections, and three wrong-to-wrong changes. Jev changes four labels in each contrast, alongside 4/90 repeat disagreements in both C and D. Its 4/90 difference between conditions is therefore comparable to the observed repeat variability. Flash-Lite changes 7/90 for B–C and 5/90 for C–D, with 6/90 and 9/90 within-arm disagreements in C and D.
blocks.zh: 一些判决也随着产出工作量或按固定目录可见度要求的顺序而改变。 Quen修改了B-C的3/90标签和C-D的15/90标签;后者包括3个回归、9个更正和3个错对错的更改。 Jev在每一对比中都修改了四个标签,同时在C和D中重复了分歧。 因此,它的条件之间的4/90差异可与观察到的重复性差异相比。 B-C和C-D各有7/90和5/90,C和D各有6/90和9/90之间的武装内部分歧。

blocks.en: Jev and Flash-Lite each keep 21/30 anchors correct across all twelve responses (Table 11 ). Their strict-stable counts are higher, at 24/30 and 25/30, because they also retain three and four stable errors. Qwen has 17 stable-correct and two stable-wrong anchors. These counts show why agreement must be assessed against gold labels: persistent errors contribute to label consistency without contributing to persistent correctness.
blocks.zh: Jev和Flash-Lite各在所有12个答复中保持21/30锚正确(表11)。 在24/30和25/30时,它们的严格稳定计数较高,因为它们还保留了3和4个稳定的差错。 奎恩拥有17个稳定正确和2个稳定错误锚. 这些清点表明为什么必须根据金色标签评估协议:持续错误有助于标签的一致性,而无助于持续的正确性。

blocks.en: Finding 5: Stability and reliability are distinct even under repeated controls. Separating stable-correct, stable-wrong, and unstable outcomes reveals a distinction that neither a single accuracy nor an undifferentiated agreement rate captures.
blocks.zh: 调查结果5:即使一再受到控制,稳定性和可靠性也是不同的。 分离稳定正确、稳定错误和不稳定的结果揭示出一种区分,既不能单一准确,也不能不加区别地获取协议率。

Twenty remain label-consistent, including four stable errors. Alongside Qwen4B, this provides a second case in which agreement under unchanged requests coexists with sensitivity to request configuration. The size comparison remains exploratory, with ten document clusters and specific inference settings. Appendix J reports coverage, output length, and latency.

blocks.en: The later API evaluations further distinguish baseline accuracy from correctness across all twelve responses. Sonnet keeps 23/30 anchors correct throughout, Haiku keeps 22/30, and Terra keeps 19/30, compared with 21/30 for Jev and Flash-Lite. Their descriptive 95% intervals are 56.67–93.33% for Sonnet, 60.00–86.67% for Haiku, and 43.33–83.33% for Terra. Terra has slightly higher baseline accuracy than Sonnet, but fewer anchors remain correct throughout. The baseline and anchor panels contain different contracts and judgments, so this ranking difference alone does not isolate request sensitivity. These counts describe ten contract clusters and do not establish a general stability ranking.

blocks.en: The generative models receive the following classification instruction: Classify each statement using only the supplied contract. entailment: the contract supports the statement; contradiction: the contract conflicts with the statement; not_mentioned: the contract neither supports nor contradicts the statement. Each input contains the full contract and the requested hypotheses, and the output schema requires one valid label per requested hypothesis. blocks.en: Other legal benchmarks define related tasks but do not extend the scope of the present evidence. LexGLUE standardizes seven English legal datasets ( Chalkidis et al., 2022 ) , and MAUD annotates the interpretation of merger-agreement provisions ( Wang et al., 2023 ) ; our ContractNLI results do not establish generalization to either setting. Contextual calibration addresses answer biases in few-shot prompting ( Zhao et al., 2021 ) , while experiments on prompted NLI show that strong predictive performance can persist under irrelevant or misleading instructions ( Webson and Pavlick, 2022 ) . These findings motivate distinguishing classification scores from sensitivity to input design. Our comparisons keep the classification instruction fixed and use no demonstrations. Score distributions characterize variability across training runs ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2017 ) ; our repeated requests instead describe inference-time variability under a fixed configuration. Computation allocated to model selection can also affect experimental comparisons ( Dodge et al., 2019 ) , and AI-agent evaluation emphasizes expenditure alongside task performance ( Kapoor et al., 2025 ) . Together, these perspectives motivate joint quality–cost reporting, with request times and provider charges interpreted within the configurations that produced them.

blocks.en: We compare two configurations of each Qwen model on the same ten development contracts, 30 anchors, four conditions, and three repeats. The historical configuration disables thinking, uses temperature zero, and permits 2,048 output tokens per anchor request. The reasoning-enabled configuration uses temperature 1, top- p p 0.95, and a shared allowance of 32,768 tokens for reasoning and the final answer, without a separate reasoning cutoff. These sampling controls define an explicit experimental configuration rather than the complete vendor-recommended decoding recipe. Each configuration is evaluated on all 360 planned requests per model.

All 360 planned requests are attempted under each configuration. Off uses temperature zero and a 2,048-token limit; On uses temperature 1, top- p p 0.95 and a 32,768-token combined reasoning-and-answer limit without a separate reasoning cutoff. The reasoning-enabled collections include two and three truncated responses, respectively, which remain in all intended-target denominators. Higher average correctness thus need not translate into more targets that are correct on every trial.

blocks.en: Reasoning, temperature, and generation allowance change together in this comparison, so the results concern the complete inference configuration rather than reasoning alone. Both intervals include zero. These development controls remain separate from the official-test observations; Appendix L explains how budget-exhausted responses are scored.
