blocks.en: Appendix L Generation-Budget Exhaustion
blocks.zh: 附录L 生成预算 用尽

blocks.en: The six completed reasoning-enabled Qwen evaluations reported here contain seventeen truncated responses. Qwen3.5-4B has two in its development anchor control, six in its test baseline, and three in its test stability evaluation. Qwen3.5-9B has three in its development anchor control, one in its test baseline, and two in its test stability evaluation. The latter two occur on different targets in condition D and remain in the intended denominators. Each truncated response returns a reasoning trace, reaches the configured limit of 32,768 generated tokens, and provides no final answer. Development and test scores remain separate, as do the historical thinking-disabled results.
blocks.zh: 本文中报告的6项经过推理证明的昆文评价载有17项简短的答复。 Quen3.5-4B在开发锚控制中有两个,在测试基线中有两个,在测试稳定性评价中有三个. Quen3.5-9B在开发锚控中有三个,一个在测试基线,两个在测试稳定性评价中. 后两种情况发生在条件D的不同目标上,并留在预定分母中。 每个截断的响应返回一个推理跟踪,达到配置的32,768个生成的代号的极限,没有给出最终的答案. 发展和测试得分仍然分开,历史思维障碍的结果也是如此。

blocks.en: With reasoning enabled, this configuration uses temperature 1 and top- p p 0.95. Reasoning and the final answer share a single generation allowance, with natural termination and no separate reasoning cutoff or reserved answer budget. A response may therefore consume its allowance before reaching the required decisions. The recorded termination establishes a failure to complete within the evaluated configuration. It does not reveal whether the reasoning was repetitive, whether a larger allowance would have produced an answer, or whether the model lacked the necessary task knowledge. We classify these cases as budget-exhausted responses, separately from transport failures that return no model response.
blocks.zh: 随着推理的启用,这种配置使用温度1和顶级-p 0.95. 理性和最后答案共享单一世代津贴,自然终止,没有单独的推理截断或保留答案预算。 因此,在做出必要的决定之前,答复可能消耗其备抵。 记录的终止证明未能在评价的配置内完成。 它没有显示这种推理是否重复,较大的允许性是否会产生答案,或者模型是否缺乏必要的任务知识。 我们将这些案例归类为预算已尽的对策,与运输故障分开,因为运输故障没有产生模式对策。

blocks.en: Our accuracy measure concerns usable decisions from a single attempt under the stated configuration. A truncated response without final labels remains in the intended-target denominator and contributes no correct predictions. For a joint baseline request, this means zero correct labels among its 17 targets. In the anchor study, an affected target cannot satisfy the requirement of correctness across all four conditions and three repeats. A missing decision also provides no evidence of a stable wrong label; label-change rates continue to use valid pairs with their coverage reported. Generated tokens and elapsed time from failed attempts are retained in resource accounting, and unavailable monetary costs remain unknown.
blocks.zh: 我们的准确性衡量标准涉及在既定配置下进行的一次尝试中作出的可用决定。 在预定目标分母中保留了没有最终标签的短篇反应,无助于正确的预测。 对于联合基准请求,这意味着在其17个目标中标注为零。 在锚地研究中,受影响的目标不能满足所有四个条件和三个重复的正确性要求。 缺失的决定也没有提供稳定错误标签的证据;标签变更率继续使用有效对并报告其覆盖范围。 资源核算中保留了因尝试失败而产生的代币和经过的时间,而无法支付的货币费用仍然不明。

blocks.en: Retaining unfinished responses preserves the single-attempt evaluation. Excluding them would condition accuracy on successful completion, while selectively replacing them would give some requests additional opportunities to finish. Replacement would also conceal failures in the twelve-response correctness criterion. The unsuccessful attempts therefore remain part of the reported accuracy, stability, and cost. A separate retry policy would require explicit eligibility and stopping rules, together with the cost and time of every attempt; its results would characterize that policy rather than replace the original observations.
blocks.zh: 保留未完成的回复保留了单试评价. 将它们排除在外,会以成功完成为条件,而有选择地取代它们,会给一些请求带来更多的完成机会。 替换还将掩盖十二反应正确性标准中的失败。 因此,不成功的尝试仍然是所报告的准确性、稳定性和成本的一部分。 一项单独的重试政策将需要明确的资格和停止规则,以及每次尝试的成本和时间;其结果将是该政策的特点,而不是取代原先的意见。

blocks.en: This treatment has a direct precedent: Bashari et al. (2026) count responses without a complete answer within a 32,768-token limit as incorrect in their reasoning-model comparison (Appendix B.3). Other settings allow different procedures. MathArena considers changing API providers and rerunning a model when frequent truncation suggests a provider-imposed generation limit ( Balunovic et al., 2025 , Section 3.3) . Our choice follows the evaluation objective and the observed termination evidence; it is not a general prohibition on retries. A larger allowance or an explicit transition from reasoning to answering would define an additional inference configuration, whose quality and resource use would require separate evaluation.
blocks.zh: 这种处理有直接的先例:巴沙里等人(2026年)在32,768个托肯限度内没有完整回答的回答,认为其推理-模型比较不正确(附录B.3). 其他设置允许不同的程序. MathArena考虑改变API供应商,并在频繁的截断表明供应商设定的发电限制时重新运行一个模型(Balunovic等人,2025年,第3.3节)。 我们的选择遵循评价目标和观察到的终止证据;这不是普遍禁止重复。 从推理到回答的更大幅度或明确过渡,将确定一个额外的推论配置,其质量和资源使用需要单独评价。

blocks.en: One Gemini Pro test stability request is unsuccessful without a recorded model answer or token usage. The available error record cannot distinguish a transport failure from a response-decoding failure, so neither model reasoning nor generation-budget exhaustion can be identified as the cause. The judgment remains unsuccessful in the primary analysis, and its elapsed time is retained. Recorded stability expenditure totals $2.920162 for 359 of 360 requests. The remaining charge is unknown, so this is a known subtotal rather than a complete cost total. Any service-recovery retry would require a separate stated policy and would not erase the original observation.
blocks.zh: 一个双子座 没有记录的模型解答或符号使用,Pro测试稳定性请求不成功. 现有的错误记录无法区分运输故障与响应-解码故障,因此模型推理和生成-预算耗尽都不能被确定为原因. 这项判决在初步分析中仍然不成功,而且其时间已过。 在360项请求中,有记录的稳定支出共计2.920162美元。 其余费用不详,因此这是已知的小计,而不是全部费用总额。 任何服务回收再试验都需要单独的政策,不会抹去原先的意见。

blocks.en: Appendix M Response Time and Output Workload
blocks.zh: 附录M 反应时间和产出工作量

blocks.en: Table 23 and Figure 6 summarize recorded response times for all ten official-test configurations. The baseline includes 123 joint requests per model, each requesting 17 labels. The stability panel includes 90 requests per condition: three repeats on each of 30 contracts. All attempted requests contribute their observed elapsed time, including invalid or truncated responses and the Gemini Pro request without a recorded answer. These timing summaries therefore describe attempted requests rather than time conditional on a successful answer.
blocks.zh: 表23和图6汇总了所有10个正式测试配置的记录答复时间。 基准包括每个模型123项联合请求,每个请求17个标签。 稳定小组每个条件包括90项请求:30份合同每份3份重复。 所有未遂请求都贡献了所观察到的过去时间,包括无效或短短的答复和没有记录答复的双子计划请求。 因此,这些时间安排摘要描述了试图提出的请求,而不是以成功答复为条件的时间。

blocks.en: All collections use the same client machine, with one in-flight request per model and no automatic retries. The client timer spans the prediction call, including request preparation, connection establishment, network transfer, service-side processing, and response validation. The original seven-model stability collection also times construction of the condition-specific payload; the later three-model extension prepares that payload before starting the timer. Collections occur at different times and retain their provider routes and default caching behavior. Thus, these measurements compare the observed deployments and inference configurations. They do not isolate model computation, equalize hardware or reasoning budgets, or measure maximum throughput. Separate server computation, queueing, and first-token timings were not recorded.
blocks.zh: 所有集合都使用同一客户端机,每个型号有一个飞行中请求,没有自动重试. 客户端定时器横跨预测呼叫,包括请求准备,连接建立,网络传输,服务端处理,以及响应验证. 最初的七型机车稳定性收集也为特定条件有效载荷的构造提供了时间;后来的三型机车扩展则在启动定时器之前准备该有效载荷. 收藏在不同的时间发生,并保留其提供商路线和默认的缓存行为. 因此,这些测量比较了观测到的部署和推论配置. 它们不孤立模型计算,不平衡硬件或推理预算,也不测量最大吞吐量. 未记录单独的服务器计算、队列和先键计时 。

blocks.en: Conditions B and C keep all 17 hypotheses visible while requesting one label and 17 labels, respectively. Their comparison changes output workload and structure. Table 23 reports the median time in each condition and the median of 90 paired elapsed-time differences, matched by contract and repeat. The latter is computed from t C − t B t_{C}-t_{B} for each pair and need not equal the difference between the two condition medians. Its descriptive 95% intervals resample all three repeats together within each of the 30 contracts, using 5,000 paired bootstrap draws without multiplicity adjustment. Failures remain in these timing pairs.
blocks.zh: 条件B和C保持所有17个假说可见,同时分别要求一个标签和17个标签. 它们的比较改变了产出工作量和结构。 表23报告每种情况的中位时间和90对时间差的中位时间,并附有合同和重复。 后者是从t C − t B → t → t → b → t → B → 每对计算,不需要等于两个条件中位数的差数。 其描述性95%的间隔在30份合同中每份合同中全部重复一次,使用5 000对靴子抽图,不作多重调整。 失败仍然存在于这些计时对中。

blocks.en: Jev has the lowest observed baseline median and P95 response times. At fixed visible content, its median changes little when 17 labels are requested instead of one. This small increase is useful for characterizing the service, but does not establish a causal explanation in terms of internal parallelism. Fixed connection and network overhead, caching, and serving policies can also affect how elapsed time changes with output workload. The timing comparison should be read alongside correctness and request validity, rather than as a claim about an isolated model architecture.

blocks.en: Table 23: Client elapsed time for all ten model configurations. The baseline uses 123 contracts with 17 requested judgments per contract. Conditions B and C both show 17 hypotheses and request one or 17 judgments, respectively; each uses 30 contracts and three repeats (90 calls). All attempts, including failures, are retained. Paired changes match contract and repeat; 95% intervals resample whole contracts 5,000 times. P95 uses linear interpolation. Timings include client, network, and service effects. Bold and underlining mark the lowest and second-lowest baseline values, without implying significance.
blocks.zh: 表23:所有10个模型配置的客户用完的时间。 基线采用123项合同,每项合同要求作出17项判决。 条件B和C都分别显示17个假设,并要求作出1个或17个判决;每个都使用30个合同和3个重复(90个电话)。 所有尝试,包括失败,均予保留。 Paired更改匹配合同并重复;95%的间隔重新模拟整个合同5000次. P95采用线性插值. 时机包括客户端,网络,和服务效果. 粗体和下划线标出最低和次低基线值,但不暗示意义。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Jev has the lowest baseline median latency among the tested configurations, with a small additional delay when more judgments are requested. Left: median and 95th-percentile client elapsed time for 123 joint requests per model. Right: median time for requesting one or 17 judgments from the same visible hypothesis catalog (90 requests per condition). All attempts, including invalid responses, are retained. Provider routes and inference settings differ; these measurements do not isolate model computation or establish an architectural cause.
